title: S4 tracing lens — input
description: Unlike every other S4 lens's input.schema.json, `points` here is NOT filtered to one kind -- tracing is cross-cutting per architecture.md, so it receives points of every kind S1 has detected.

points.description: surface_map.json points of any kind -- the lens designs a propagation-risk signal for each, regardless of which SDK it calls.

sync_nature.description: S1-determined: whether the call site sits inside an async def (real AST fact) -- absent means S1 has not determined it.

context.description: context.yaml, if an interview has run -- optional; the lens must produce valid, complete signals for every point with or without it.
